author: Arendeth
description: Forgedborn Race: At Construction level 10, learn Forgedborn Assembly, build an Assembly Cradle, and perform the ritual to become Forgedborn. Forgedborn are crafted rather than born and never hunger, thirst, tire, or suffer poison. They wear no clothes and use swappable forged parts (clay, stone, bronze, steel) for their head, torso, legs, and both hands. Credits: Arendeth (design); built with Claude (Anthropic); and Artur Smiarowski for Soulash 2.
name: Forgeborn Golem Race
